tools.subtitle: 88 curated Kali Linux tools across 14 categories — ready to run in your browser. No setup, no installs.

q1.q: Is CyberSec Pro legal to use?
q1.a: Yes. CyberSec Pro is designed for authorized security testing only. You must have explicit written permission to scan any target. Unauthorized testing is illegal and violates our Terms of Service.

q2.q: Do I need to install anything?
q2.a: No. Everything runs in your browser — no local installation, no VMs, no configuration. Just sign up, add a target, and start scanning.

q3.a: CyberSec Pro provides 88 Kali Linux tools across 14 categories, including Nmap, Nuclei, WPScan, SQLMap, Nikto, Hydra, and many more. Tool availability depends on your plan tier.

q4.a: We offer Quick Scan (top 20 tools, 5-15 min), Full Scan (all tools in your plan, 1-4 hours), Custom Scan (hand-picked tools with custom parameters), and Scheduled Scan (recurring daily/weekly/monthly).

q5.a: We support PDF, HTML, JSON, CSV, and Markdown formats. All reports include CVSS scoring, remediation guidance, and compliance mapping (OWASP, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, NIST).

q6.a: Absolutely. All data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Our controls are designed to align with SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, and we never share your scan results with third parties.

q7.q: Can I use it for my company?
q7.a: Yes. Professional and Enterprise plans include team collaboration, multi-tenant workspaces, role-based access controls (Owner, Admin, Analyst), and centralized billing.

q8.a: Before scanning, you must verify target ownership via DNS TXT record, HTTP file upload, or HTML meta tag. This prevents unauthorized scanning and ensures compliance with security testing laws.

q9.q: What happens if a scan finds vulnerabilities?
q9.a: Each vulnerability is categorized by CVSS severity (Critical, High, Medium, Low, Info) with detailed remediation steps, affected components, and references to CVE databases. You can export findings directly to your ticketing system.

q10.q: Can I cancel or change my plan anytime?
q10.a: Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time from your dashboard. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing cycle. No long-term contracts.

q11.a: Yes. Our REST API supports 130+ endpoints for programmatic access to scans, results, reports, and team management. Available on Starter plans and above with full API documentation.

q12.a: CyberSec Pro maps findings to OWASP Top 10 (2021), PCI-DSS v4.0, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls v8, MITRE ATT&CK, SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR frameworks.

dataResidency.title: Data Residency & Privacy
dataResidency.subtitle: Your data stays in Canada. Always.
dataResidency.storageDescription: All customer data, scan results, and logs are stored exclusively in Canadian data centers. No data leaves Canadian jurisdiction without explicit customer consent.
dataResidency.encryptionDescription: Secrets and stored credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The encryption key is separate from the token-signing key, lives only in the server environment, and is never written to the database, the backups or the repository.
dataResidency.encryptionInTransitDescription: All API and web traffic uses TLS 1.3 with perfect forward secrecy. Cipher suites are restricted to the strongest available configurations.
dataResidency.noLoggingDescription: We do not log, store, or process raw network traffic or scan payloads. Only metadata (timestamps, target IPs, tool types, severity counts) is retained for operational purposes.
dataResidency.noLoggingPolicy3: No personal data in scan results
dataResidency.noLoggingPolicy4: Scan results are purged automatically after 90 days, audit logs after a year
dataResidency.dataProcessing1: Purpose limitation — data collected only for stated security scanning purposes
dataResidency.dataProcessing2: Data minimization — we collect the minimum data necessary
dataResidency.dataProcessing3: Transparency — you always know what data we store and why
dataResidency.dataProcessing4: User control — you can export or delete your data at any time

trustFeatures.title: Encryption in transit and at rest
trustFeatures.description: TLS 1.3 with perfect forward secrecy on every connection. Secrets and stored credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, under a key held separately from the token-signing key.

trustFeatures.title: Isolated execution
trustFeatures.description: Scans run server-side in a dedicated scan container, one process per job. The command is tokenised before any of your values are substituted, so no shell is involved, and every query is scoped to your organization.

trustFeatures.title: SOC 2-aligned controls
trustFeatures.description: Infrastructure designed against the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability, Confidentiality, Privacy). The Type II audit has not been completed — the framework table below says exactly where each one stands.

trustFeatures.title: Append-only audit logging
trustFeatures.description: Privileged actions are written to an append-only audit log, scoped to your organization and queryable from the dashboard. Logs are retained for a year.

trustFeatures.title: MFA, SSO and roles
trustFeatures.description: Multi-factor authentication over TOTP with single-use backup codes. SAML 2.0, OIDC and LDAP / Active Directory single sign-on on Enterprise. Role-based access control is enforced on the server, not in the UI.

trustFeatures.title: Maintained toolchain
trustFeatures.description: Scanner images and their vulnerability templates are rebuilt and redeployed by us. You never update a scanner, and you never patch a Kali box.

trustFeatures.title: Data minimization
trustFeatures.description: We store scan metadata and findings, not raw traffic. Retention is configurable, and you can export or delete your data at any time. GDPR Article 5(1)(c).

trustFeatures.title: Platform monitoring
trustFeatures.description: Rate limiting with cost tiers on every endpoint, statistical anomaly detection on account activity, and health watchdogs that restart a failed service without waiting for a human.

items.q: What do I get on the free trial?
items.a: Fourteen days, three scans a day, and all 88 tools — the same catalogue paid plans get. Findings and PDF reports are included; HTML and compliance reports, scheduling and the AI features are not.

One run of one tool against one target. Re-running the same tool to verify a fix counts again, and the result is linked to the original so you can see what was fixed, what is still open and what is new.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my plan?
items.a: Yes, from the Stripe customer portal in your billing settings. Upgrades take effect immediately; cancellations run to the end of the period you have paid for.
Within 14 days of purchase, provided no scans have been executed on the account. That condition is in the Terms and we apply it as written.

items.q: How much does annual billing save?
items.a: 20%. Starter is $279 a year instead of $348, Professional $949 instead of $1,188, Enterprise $3,349 instead of $4,188.
In Canada. Scan results, findings and logs stay in Canadian data centres, and nothing leaves Canadian jurisdiction without your explicit consent.

items.q: Do you store the credentials I enter for a scan?
items.a: No. Credentials for a scan are held in memory for the length of that job and discarded when it ends. They are never written to the database, to logs or to backups, and they are redacted before anything is persisted. You can also resolve them at run time from your own vault.

items.q: Which plan do I need for SSO?
items.a: Enterprise. It covers SAML 2.0, OIDC and LDAP, and the connection test validates the real endpoint rather than only saving the form.
